verdicts.reason: A: the headline is jammed against the left and top edges and looks clipped. The GROVE wordmark sits after the headline, in the middle of the banner, which breaks the reading order. The FREE DELIVERY badge collides with the small product art, and the body copy is illegibly tiny. B reads in a sensible left-to-right order (GROVE, headline, product, CTA cluster), but the FREE DELIVERY badge still sits on top of the product, the body text is unreadably small, and the CTA is a tiny pill crammed next to two badges, so it doesn't stand out.
